correctness.rationale: For every fixed strict sign pattern, the gauge-transformed healthy equilibrium is the unique solution of a strictly positive definite M-matrix system. Direct leaf elimination proves the exact necessary and sufficient positivity tests. At w>=m+3 the tests exhaust all sign patterns and no switching boundary can solve the equations; binomial summation gives the exact parity-dependent number. Infection satisfies a globally stable Metzler comparison bound with spectral abscissa -1+(sqrt(m)+1)/(4m)<0. Each feasible disease-free equilibrium has a lower-block-triangular Jacobian, a strictly Hurwitz disease block and a negative definite opinion block. All these steps hold analytically for every integer m>=1, with exact Fraction checks for m<=10 and the m=3,w=2 witness.

Thus its global graph-scope is not broader coverage of this model.

originality.rationale: The originating 2026 epidemic–opinion paper provides the equations, a skeptical healthy state, and an epidemic spectral eradication bound, but not an exact complete star census of multiple attracting healthy beliefs. Full relevant texts of the closest same-model published endemic result and a superficially similar sign-resolvent result were compared at the vector-field and implication level; neither contains this domain-specific count or simultaneous epidemic eradication. Classic signed gauge methods are openly treated as background. This is bounded originality, not independently certified priority.
residual_risks: Broader historical sign-switching opinion literature may contain a similar positivity-count argument under an equivalent state transformation not identified by the bounded search.
The Altafini primary paper was not fully read; it is acknowledged as methodological background rather than certified noncoverage.
The new exact graph family and dynamics have no independent expert validation; current literature access cannot prove absolute priority.

value.rationale: The source motivates joint infection and opinion convergence but does not determine how many post-eradication belief equilibria survive. This theorem completely classifies that natural invariant for an unbounded star family, identifies exponentially many simultaneous robust local sinks in the full coupled system, and demonstrates that guaranteed infection extinction need not imply uniqueness of health-related opinion. It is a structural existence/classification result beyond local stability of one state or a routine finite tally.
